多智能体系统

[MA-0] LesionAgent : Training-Free Agent ic Tumor Tracking and Response Assessment in Longitudinal CT

【速读】：该论文旨在解决肺癌等疾病在纵向计算机断层扫描（CT）影像随访中，自动病变检测与追踪系统无法像放射科医生一样进行整体性、符合临床指南的综合判断这一核心问题。现有3D基础模型虽能实现病灶检测、分割、配准与追踪，但缺乏对病灶“是否为新发”“是否为同一病灶”的辨识能力，也未能遵循临床指南对治疗响应做出一致性评估。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为LesionAgent的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体架构，该架构不依赖特定任务微调，而是通过“工具调用框架”（harness）将冻结的3D基础模型作为可信赖工具使用，结合坐标标注的三维视角操作能力、跨时间访问的病灶注册记忆库、对所有模型输出的验证机制以及由确定性规则引擎驱动的临床决策逻辑，实现了从影像读取到响应判定的端到端自动化。实验证明，该框架显著提升了病灶追踪完整率与测量精度，在4个公开纵向CT数据集上优于所有自动基线方法；在23次临床随访中，其判断与放射科医生一致率达20/23，且未在DeepLesion数据集上训练即超越所有基于该数据集训练的追踪器。关键差异并非来自语言模型本身，而是其结构化集成框架：相同模型条件下，无此框架时检测F1仅为41%，而引入后提升至78%；开放权重模型在框架支持下亦从6%跃升至73%。因此，该研究的核心贡献在于证明了“智能体架构”（agent architecture）相较于单纯模型性能提升，对临床影像智能系统的实际效能具有决定性影响。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27876
作者: Maximilian Rokuss,Jeya Maria Jose Valanarasu,Alejandro Lozano,Benjamin Hamm,Yannick Kirchhoff,Fabian Isensee,Klaus Maier-Hein
机构: German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), Heidelberg, Germany; Stanford University; HIDSS4Health, Heidelberg; National Center for Tumor Diseases (NCT) Heidelberg, Germany; Pattern Analysis and Learning Group, Department of Radiation Oncology, Heidelberg University Hospital, Germany
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Every few months, a cancer patient’s CT scans decide whether treatment continues. 3D foundation models can now detect, segment, register and track lesions, yet none of them reads the scans as a radiologist does. A radiologist decides which findings are lesions, which are the same lesion months later and whether a new spot means progression, and checks each decision against the extensive rules of a clinical guideline. We introduce LesionAgent, an LLM agent that performs this read end to end without task-specific training. It operates frozen 3D models as tools, acts in 3D through coordinate-labelled views, remembers every lesion across visits in a registry, verifies every model output it relies on, and leaves every number to a deterministic guideline engine. On four public longitudinal CT datasets, LesionAgent tracks more lesions and measures them more accurately than every automatic baseline, and where the same 3D models chained by fixed rules call progression falsely at 33 of 56 follow-ups, it does so twice. On clinical follow-up CTs, it agrees with the radiologists’ response at 20 of 23 follow-ups, including every change in response, and without training on DeepLesion, it retrieves more of its lesions than every tracker trained on it (89.0% vs. 87.4%). Its harness, not its LLM, makes the difference: given the same LLM and 3D models but not the harness, Claude Code reaches a detection F1 of 41% and LesionAgent 78%, and an open-weight LLM that can run inside the hospital rises from 6% to 73%. LesionAgent and a napari reading app for any LLM are available at this https URL.

[MA-1] Beyond Self-Critique: Epistemic Convergence Control for Multi-Agent Research Verification

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体科学论断验证系统中两个关键问题：其一是当各辩论智能体基于同一基础大模型实例化时，存在共享潜在表征导致的自我批判偏差（self-critique bias）；其二是固定迭代次数的辩论协议易造成过早终止或收敛后仍持续消耗计算资源。解决方案的关键在于提出一种对称性破缺的角色架构（asymmetric role architecture），包含主张者（Advocate）、质疑者（Skeptic）与仲裁者（Arbitrator），三者具有相反的认知目标，显著降低了角色嵌入相似度（0.852 vs. 0.918，p = 5.82 × 10⁻⁸），并更有效地揭示争议性论断（22.0% vs. 15.4%）。同时，引入基于证据的信念差（Belief-Delta, ΔB）收敛准则，作为可解释的停止规则，在避免过度迭代（0% vs. 62.5% for Fixed-3）的同时减少约2.4倍的大语言模型调用。此外，每个支持的论断均锚定于经独立自然语言推理（NLI）分类器审计的原文片段，实现可审计的证据溯源，将幻觉率控制在21.7%（与自修正批评者25.9%无显著差异，p = 0.61），兼顾了验证严谨性与计算效率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27839
作者: Chrisantus Eze
机构: Oklahoma State University (奥克拉荷马州立大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Accepted at ICAART 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems for scientific claim verification increasingly rely on role-structured LLM debate to pressure-test hypotheses. However, when debating agents are instantiated from the same underlying base model, they share identical latent representations, making self-critique bias structurally inevitable. Static fixed-iteration protocols compound this by either halting prematurely before evidence stabilizes or wasting inference compute after convergence. We present \sys, a multi-agent research verification framework that addresses both failure modes. First, we introduce an asymmetric role architecture comprising an Advocate, Skeptic, and Arbitrator with opposing epistemic directives, producing significantly lower role-embedding similarity (0.852 vs.\ 0.918 for symmetric Multi-Agent Debate [MAD], p = 5.82 \times 10^-8 ) and surfacing more contested claims (22.0% vs.\ 15.4%). Second, we propose the Belief-Delta ( \DB ) convergence criterion, an evidence-grounded stopping rule that eliminates over-iteration (0.0% vs.\ 62.5% for Fixed- 3 ) while cutting LLM calls by 2.4 \times . Third, each supported claim is anchored to a verbatim literature snippet audited by an independent NLI classifier, achieving a 21.7% hallucination rate (comparable to 25.9% for a Self-Refine critic, p = 0.61 ) while establishing auditable evidence grounding. Across 200 runs on 40 research hypotheses evaluated with DeepSeek-R1-32B, \sys balances compute efficiency with rigorous epistemic verification.

[MA-2] A Cognitive Agent ic AI Framework for Interactive Process Analysis and Optimization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决复杂多变量过程分析与优化中跨多个异构软件工具（如仿真、结构化数据、机器学习、优化算法及科学文献）协同困难的问题，尤其在各工具间缺乏集成的情况下，导致效率低下且易出错。其核心解决方案是提出一种认知型代理式人工智能框架（Cognitive Agentic AI Framework, CAAF），关键在于通过大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）承担任务理解、规划、知识融合与上下文管理等认知性任务，同时将数值计算、仿真与优化等具体操作交由专用工具（如COCO流程模拟器、基于机器学习的贝叶斯优化、文献检索系统和数据库接口）执行，实现“认知-执行”分离的高效协同。该框架以自然语言提示为交互方式，在固定流程拓扑下支持工程师进行迭代式探索，成功应用于乙酸甲酯生产过程的多变量优化，通过4,000次贝叶斯优化迭代，使碳转化率（C-Yield）从初始数据集的约0.81提升至0.921（提升约11个百分点），并验证了预测结果与仿真结果高度一致（平均绝对误差仅0.0085）。此外，CAAF具备自动检测非收敛仿真、排除无效输出并持续优化的能力，体现了人机协同驱动下基于严格仿真验证的迭代分析与优化范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27725
作者: Trung Ngoc Trinha,Roman Tschentscher,Trong Dong Nguyen,Trung Thanh Nguyen,Anna Trubetskaya
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Complex multivariable process analysis and optimization require coordinated access to simulation, structured data, machine learning (ML), optimization, and scientific literature, often across disconnected software tools. We present a Cognitive Agentic AI Framework (CAAF) that enables interactive, iterative process investigation through natural-language prompts within an established flowsheet. Following harness-engineering principles, CAAF assigns task interpretation, planning, knowledge synthesis, and context management to a large language model while delegating numerical calculations to specialized tools. Dedicated providers connect databases, scientific-document retrieval, ML-assisted Bayesian optimization (BO), and COCO process simulation. The framework is demonstrated on methyl acetate production. Guided by successive prompts, an engineer explored multivariable relationships, conducted 4,000 BO iterations to maximize carbon conversion yield (C-Yield) and minimize specific energy cost (C-SEC), refined operating bounds, and verified selected candidates through process simulation. Re-simulation of 16 candidates within the restricted domain showed close agreement with ML predictions, with a mean absolute C-Yield error of 0.0085 (0.85 percentage points). The highest BO-derived C-Yield, verified by COCO, was 0.921 versus approximately 0.81 in the initial dataset, an improvement of about 11 percentage points. CAAF also detects and reports non-converged simulations, excludes invalid outputs, and continues subsequent evaluations. The results demonstrate how human-guided agentic coordination can combine engineering tools for iterative analysis and optimization with rigorous simulation-based verification under a fixed process topology.

[MA-3] Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决基于视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）的机器人操作代理在实际应用中面临的三大核心挑战：记忆组织能力不足、失败原因归因不确定，以及执行经验难以复用。为应对这些问题，提出了一种名为Embodied-Harness的双代理框架，其关键在于通过不更新模型参数的方式，实现对执行“操作框架”（execution harness）的持续优化。该框架由执行者（Actor）与反思者（Reflector）构成：执行者负责与环境交互并执行任务，而反思者则将执行过程中的证据转化为可复用的操作指导。通过分层记忆架构（Hierarchical Memory Architecture），系统能够同时维护短期执行上下文与长期经验知识，支撑实时执行与事后反思。基于证据的经验反思（Evidence-based Experience Reflection）使失败诊断建立在可观测交互基础上，而递归式框架自提升（Recursive Harness Self-Improvement）机制则实现了在多次尝试中对操作指导的渐进式优化。实验在RoboTwin 2.0、RoboSPA和RMBench三个基准上验证了该方法在环境变化下的泛化能力、空间推理、长时程规划及依赖记忆的操作任务中的有效性，分别取得82.4%、76.7%和94.4%的成功率；真实世界评估平均成功率达96.7%，充分证明了通过经验驱动的框架自提升机制显著提升了机器人操作的鲁棒性与适应性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27689
作者: Zhenxuan Fan,Zhuoya Wang,Yuqian Yuan,Wenqiao Zhang,Juncheng Li,Jun Xiao,Siliang Tang,Yueting Zhuang
机构: Zhejiang University(浙江大学); Huazhong University of Science and Technology(华中科技大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embodied-Harness in generalization under environmental variations, spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and memory-dependent manipulation. Our method achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on the three benchmarks, respectively. Real-world evaluation further yields an average success rate of 96.7% across three manipulation tasks. These results highlight the potential of Embodied-Harness to improve robotic manipulation through experience-driven harness self-improvement.

[MA-4] Bringing AI Assistance to the Beznau Nuclear Power Plant: A Hierarchical System of LLM Agents for Reactor Monitoring

【速读】：该论文旨在解决核电站运行中因长期累积式现代化导致的多源异构信息孤岛问题，具体表现为监测系统、报警日志、变量目录、技术规范和调查报告等关键数据分散在独立系统中，无法跨域协同查询。这使得在处理核心仪表异常时，工程师需依赖耗时的手动检索与经验传承，效率低下且易出错。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的分层多智能体辅助系统：由一个协调代理将工程师的问题分解为子任务，并分发给具有只读权限的专用子代理，每个子代理对应单一数据源；同时，领域知识以自然语言形式编写成可读、可审查、可修订的操作规程，确保专业可解释性；系统全程保持咨询性质，所有输出均具备可追溯性，明确标注来源。此外，研究还深入探讨了在强调安全、可追溯性和保守变更的文化背景下引入代理型AI所面临的组织挑战与适应策略，为工业设施监控中负责任地应用生成式AI提供了兼具技术可行性与管理可行性的范式参考。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27556
作者: Wenqi Zhou,Leonardo Baldo,Edwin Kolbe,Manuel Arias Chao
机构: Zurich University of Applied Science (苏黎世应用科学大学); University of Basel (巴塞尔大学); Delft University of Technology (代尔夫特理工大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Beznau Unit 1 in Switzerland, in operation since 1969, is the most experienced nuclear reactor still running worldwide. Five decades of incremental modernization have left its monitoring systems, alarm logs, variable catalogs, technical specifications and investigation reports in separate silos that were never designed to be queried together. As a result, investigating a core instrumentation anomaly means slow, manual gathering of knowledge scattered across databases, documents, and experienced colleagues. We present a hierarchical multi-agent assistant built on large language models (LLMs) to support these investigations and reduce the need for tedious manual searches in SAP systems. An orchestrating agent breaks down an engineer’s question and hands the parts to specialized sub-agents, each with read-only access to one source. Domain expertise is written as natural-language procedures that plant engineers can read, review and revise. The system is strictly advisory, with every answer traced back to its sources. We also report organizational lessons from introducing agentic AI into a culture built on safety, traceability and conservative change. Beyond the technical architecture, the Beznau case study examines how an assistant can be introduced into a setting where evidence must be traceable, changes carefully reviewed, and operational decisions retained by plant personnel, paving the way for the responsible use of agentic AI in industrial plant monitoring.

[MA-5] Epistemic Social Learning: Latent Behavioral Structure under Endogenous Multi-Agent Interaction NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体交互中学习者因自身行为影响观测数据而导致的适应性不足问题，即尽管行为模型能够较好地预测观测结果，但在对手策略发生改变时仍难以实现有效适应。其解决方案的关键在于提出**认知社会学习（Epistemic Social Learning, ESL）**框架，该框架将快速、针对特定交互的贝叶斯信念与缓慢更新的群体共享行为原型在线学习相结合。通过条件化信念进行决策，进而影响后续观测及其表征学习，形成闭环反馈机制。在满足显式正则性和平均性假设的前提下，论文提供了对这一耦合动态的条件随机逼近刻画。实验表明，在12个合成的3×3合作、协调与对抗博弈中，ESL在策略切换后的累积后悔值最低，显著优于其他在线隐状态自适应方法（包括感知切换的贝叶斯滤波器），并验证了在观测丢失、噪声干扰及非对称激励等复杂场景下的鲁棒性。研究揭示了在策略依赖型交互中，预测拟合度与决策相关适应性之间可能存在的分离现象。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27545
作者: Jainendra Shukla,Dhruv Jaiswal,Divyanshi Beniwal,Kiriti Kanjilal
机构: IIIT-Delhi(印度信息技术研究所-德里分校), New Delhi(新德里), India(印度)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 44 pages, 6 figures. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In multi-agent interaction, a learner’s actions shape the observations from which it infers other agents’ behavior. A behavioral model may predict these observations well yet support poor adaptation when opponents change. We introduce Epistemic Social Learning (ESL), which couples fast, interaction-specific Bayesian beliefs with slower online learning of population-shared behavioral prototypes. Belief-conditioned decisions influence subsequent observations and, in turn, the representations learned from them. Under explicit regularity and averaging assumptions, we provide a conditional stochastic-approximation characterization of these coupled dynamics. Across twelve synthetic 3\times3 cooperative, coordination, and adversarial games, ESL achieves the lowest aggregate post-switch regret among the evaluated online latent-adaptation methods, including a switch-aware Bayesian filter. Additional experiments examine observation loss, noise, and asymmetric incentives. These findings illustrate how predictive fit can differ from decision-relevant adaptation under policy-dependent interaction.

[MA-6] Where Delay Compensation Belongs in a Decentralized Mean-Field-Game Swarm with a Control-Barrier Safety Filter AAAI-27

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在通信受限条件下，大规模无人机集群（drone swarms）中因信息延迟导致的安全性下降问题，尤其关注由共享时分多址（TDMA）信道引起的邻居状态估计过时（staleness）对分布式控制的影响。其核心挑战在于：在仅通过轮询式、噪声测量获取局部邻近信息的场景下，随着集群规模增大，信息帧周期延长，导致控制屏障函数（CBF）安全滤波器依赖的实时状态估计严重滞后，从而引发碰撞。解决方案的关键在于引入轻量级机载预测器（on-board predictors），通过从历史广播数据中推断邻居位置（如基于恒定速度拟合或小型学习网络），补偿信息延迟带来的误差。实验表明，将预测机制部署于安全层（CBF）可显著提升系统容错能力，使允许的最大帧周期延长1.4至2.3倍，且在噪声每步重置时表现更优；而将预测应用于均场博弈（MFG）路由层仅能优化拥堵修正，无法恢复安全性。此外，研究揭示了“扩大安全裕度”这一简单替代方案反而会在瓶颈区域加剧碰撞，凸显了预测补偿应仅在未补偿极限之上启用的必要性，体现了分层控制中安全与效率的解耦设计原则。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27540

Abstract:Large robot teams are often run as a plan-then-execute stack. We study a decentralized instance for drone swarms, a mean-field-game (MFG) routing field with a per-agent control-barrier-function (CBF) safety filter, when communication is limited by a shared TDMA channel. Neighbors are known only through noisy range and bearing measurements exchanged in round-robin slots, so the frame, and with it the age of every estimate, grows with swarm size. In simulation this delay reaches both layers but breaks only the safety layer. Without delay, swarms of up to 100 agents do not collide, even with each measurement’s noise held for a whole frame; with it, stale estimates at the CBF cause collisions beyond a frame period of 125 to 175 ms, or 75 to 100 ms at 100 agents with held noise, and swarm size sets where that limit lies and how steeply collisions rise. At the MFG, staleness makes the local density noisier without biasing it, and throughput drops by at most a tenth. We then compensate with lightweight on-board predictors, from constant-velocity fits to a small learned network, that estimate each neighbor’s position from its last broadcasts. A layer-split experiment shows where prediction is needed: at the CBF it restores safety and extends the tolerated frame period by 1.4 to 1.7 times with an untrained constant-velocity fit and about 2.3 with the learned network when the noise is redrawn each step; with noise held for a frame the two extend it about equally, while at the MFG it only refines the congestion correction. A constant wider safety margin, the simplest alternative, makes collisions more frequent in a bottleneck. With the routing solved offline, that layer is robust to the delay because it sees neighbors only through a crowd average; compensation belongs in the safety filter, switched on only above the uncompensated limit, since below it the predictor’s own error adds collisions.

[MA-7] Joint Optimization of Fleet Size Localization Infrastructure and Trajectories for Multi-AUV Persistent Monitoring

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模水下基础设施（如海上风电场基础结构、输电电缆及检查通道）的持久性监测问题，核心挑战在于实现时间覆盖（temporal coverage），即在感知能力有限、导航存在不确定性以及自主水下航行器（AUV）资源受限的条件下，确保感兴趣区域在限定时间间隔内被有效重访。传统方法往往关注空间覆盖，而忽视了时间维度上的动态更新需求。论文提出通过系统性比较三类轨迹策略——确定性车道式覆盖（如割草机模式）、随机探索（带边界约束的偏置随机游走）以及协同分区策略（基于Voronoi剖分）——来分析其在不同定位精度条件下的表现。研究的关键在于揭示：当定位精度达到一定阈值后，进一步提升定位性能带来的收益趋于饱和，而协同分区轨迹设计对改善时间覆盖的贡献远大于单纯依赖高精度定位。为此，论文构建了一个成本感知的评估框架，将舰队规模、信标数量与任务能耗统一纳入综合成本函数，并通过仿真验证表明，采用协同分区轨迹可使舰队规模减小，同时实现比未针对定位基础设施优化的固定路径低39%-46%的全生命周期成本，且保持更优的时间覆盖性能，凸显了轨迹设计与定位基础设施协同优化的重要性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Persistent monitoring of large-scale subsea infrastructure, such as offshore wind farm foundations, export cables, and inspection corridors, remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous underwater systems. The problem is not solely spatial coverage, but rather temporal coverage: ensuring that all relevant regions of interest are revisited within bounded time intervals under limited sensing, navigation uncertainty, and constrained vehicle resources. We compare three classes of trajectory strategies: (1) deterministic lane-based coverage (lawnmower patterns), (2) stochastic exploration (biased random walk with boundary constraints), and (3) coordinated partition-based strategies (Voronoi tessellation). Rather than seeking a universally superior method, we evaluate how varying levels of localization accuracy impact temporal coverage across two distinct operational profiles: persistent monitoring of the entire operational workspace versus targeted inspection of critical infrastructure. We present a simulation-based, quantitatively grounded study of temporal coverage in multi-AUV persistent monitoring, disentangling three interacting design dimensions: (i) trajectory generation strategy, (ii) fleet size, and (iii) localization accuracy provided by fixed acoustic beacon infrastructure. We introduce a cost-aware evaluation framework combining fleet size, number of beacons, and mission energy expenditure into a unified cost function. Results demonstrate that beyond a certain accuracy threshold, improvements in localization yield diminishing returns compared to coordinated trajectory design, an effect often obscured in integrated navigation-planning approaches. Coordinated-partition trajectories enable a reduced fleet size to achieve superior temporal coverage at a 39-46% lower overall life-cycle cost than rigid deterministic paths unoptimized for the localization infrastructure.

[MA-8] Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agent ic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决场景图生成（Scene Graph Generation, SGG）模型在缺乏真实边界框和标签时性能下降的“黑箱”问题，即现有标准评估设置（PredCls、SGCls、SGDet）虽能反映整体性能损失，却无法定位具体失败环节及根本原因。为实现无需重新训练即可修复模型缺陷的目标，本文提出RoHa-SGG（基于根因引导的Harness优化方法），其核心在于将代理式Harness优化扩展至SGG任务。该方案的关键是引入两个大语言模型（LLM）代理：根因分析（Root-Cause Analysis, RCA）代理负责识别模型失效的具体组件并诊断失败原因，而提议代理则基于诊断结果搜索可修复问题的Harness优化策略。实验表明，不同模型与数据集上丢失的真实三元组分布存在差异，而RoHa-SGG在Visual Genome和PSG数据集上的五种模型-数据组合中均实现了所有指标的提升，其中多模态大模型的图约束召回率（R@100）与平均召回率（mR@100）分别最高提升15.8和26.4点，两阶段与单阶段模型也分别提升3.6和10.1点；同时，在根因引导下，Harness搜索效率较无引导方式最高提升三倍。

机构: Korea University(高丽大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Scene graph generation (SGG) aims to detect objects in an image and predict the relationships between them. The standard PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet settings show how much performance drops without ground-truth boxes and labels, but not where or why a model fails. Knowing this would allow fixing a model where it fails, without retraining. We propose RoHa-SGG (Root-cause-guided Harness optimization for SGG), which extends agentic harness optimization to SGG. It optimizes the harness, the inference code around a frozen SGG model. RoHa-SGG has two main LLM agents. A root-cause analysis (RCA) agent finds the components where the model fails and diagnoses why, and a proposer agent searches for a harness that fixes these causes. We evaluate RoHa-SGG on Visual Genome and PSG with representative two-stage, one-stage, and multimodal-LLM SGG models. The analysis shows that the components where ground-truth triplets are lost differ across models and datasets. RoHa-SGG improves every metric on all five model-dataset combinations. Graph-constrained R@100 and mR@100 rise by up to 15.8 and 26.4 points for the multimodal LLM and by up to 3.6 and 10.1 points for the two-stage and one-stage models. With root-cause guidance, the harness search reaches the final score of an unguided search up to three times faster.

[MA-9] Communication-constrained multiagent risk estimation: a simulation benchmark for adult sore throat

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在通信受限且不可靠的分布式预测代理环境中，如何实现多个智能体对共享预测估计进行有效协同的问题。其核心挑战在于，在有限的交互预算和高通信失败概率下，如何最小化各代理间预测结果的分歧，以达成一致的集体判断。解决方案的关键在于通过对比不同拓扑结构（完全图、环形图、星型图）下的对称成对随机交谈（symmetric pairwise gossip）机制，在多种缺失观测视角和通信故障率条件下评估预测一致性与误差分解表现。研究发现，尽管完全图在减少预测分歧方差方面表现最优（0.000109），但其整体预测性能并未超越最强个体模型（如Kumo），表明协同一致性并不等同于预测优势。该研究强调了在特定仿真假设下对有限预算协调行为的量化分析，但未提出新的通信算法或证明其临床有效性。

Abstract:Distributed predictive agents may need to approach a shared estimate under limited, unreliable communication. We evaluated classical symmetric pairwise gossip among five agents initialized from frozen calibrated predictions in a synthetic adult sore-throat benchmark. Ninety runs across three fixed generator families supplied 270,000 underlying test encounters, each observed through four missingness views. Complete, ring and star graphs were compared at eight interaction budgets and transaction failure probabilities of 0, 0.2 and 0.5. The coordination extension was designed after inspection of the predictive benchmark and is exploratory. Outcomes were disagreement around the conserved arithmetic mean and its exact decomposition of mean-agent Brier error. In the base view at eight attempted pairs and 0.2 failure, disagreement variance was 0.000109 for the complete graph, 0.000134 for the ring and 0.000175 for the star. The paired complete-minus-ring difference was -0.000024 (95% Monte Carlo interval -0.000030 to -0.000019). The centralized mean had base Brier 0.069781, compared with 0.069368 for Kumo alone. Agreement therefore does not establish superiority to the strongest individual predictor. Code, fixed probability inputs and results support replay without model refitting. The study quantifies finite-budget coordination under specified simulation assumptions; it proposes no new gossip algorithm and establishes no clinical accuracy or utility.

[MA-10] sting for Coordination Failures in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决深度并行协同多智能体强化学习（Deep Parallel Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, CMARL）中潜在的安全性问题，即在未显式建模于奖励函数中的隐式安全约束下，多智能体系统可能产生难以解释的不安全行为。与单智能体强化学习（Single-Agent RL）相比，针对CMARL策略的安全性测试研究相对不足。为此，论文提出一种名为DisQ的测试用例选择方法，其核心创新在于利用训练后Q-learning智能体特有的可解释信号——Q值差距（Q-value gap），该指标能够量化各智能体对当前状态可达回报的估计差异。当该差距超过预设校准阈值时，表明存在潜在的协作失调风险，从而标识出可能暴露缺陷的状态。DisQ通过优先执行具有显著Q值差距的状态，跳过无明显分歧的状态，实现高效的目标状态筛选。实验结果表明，在四个典型CMARL基准环境中的多数配置下，DisQ相较于直接应用于CMARL的单智能体测试方法（如随机测试和基于遗传算法的搜索测试），显著提升了故障检测能力。本研究的主要贡献包括：1）提出可从单一状态计算、无需执行系统的可解释指标——Q值差距，用于识别潜在的多智能体协作失效；2）设计了适应现有单智能体测试方法的新型测试用例选择框架DisQ，有效扩展了传统安全性测试范式至多智能体场景。

Abstract:Deep parallel cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (CMARL) trains multiple agents that all act at every time step to optimize a common objective. Like single-agent RL, CMARL can produce unsafe behaviors that violate implicit safety requirements not captured by the reward, and these behaviors are hard to explain. However, testing CMARL policies for safety has received less attention than the safety testing of single-agent RL policies. In this paper, we propose DisQ, a test case selection method that identifies failure-revealing states in value-based CMARL by exploiting a signal specific to trained Q-learning agents. The signal is the Q-value gap, an explainable metric that flags a state when the agents’ estimates of the achievable return diverge by more than a calibrated threshold. DisQ selects such states for execution and skips those without a gap. Our experiments in four CMARL benchmark environments show that, in most of the evaluated configurations, DisQ improves failure detection over single-agent RL testing methods applied to CMARL, namely random testing and search-based testing with genetic algorithms. Our main contributions are the Q-value gap, an indicator of potential miscoordination computable from a single state without executing the system, and DisQ, a test case selection method that adapts existing single-agent testing methods to CMARL.

[MA-11] OpenRing: Deadlock-Free Execution of Any Planner on AGV Floors with One-Way Lanes

【速读】：该论文旨在解决持续运行的多智能体路径规划（lifelong multi-agent path finding）中因车辆路径偏移或规划器失效导致的环路死锁问题，尤其在单向车道环境下，晚到车辆或丢失的规划器可能封闭由全段组成的环路，引发系统停滞。其解决方案的关键在于将“道路运行速度”与“系统是否持续运行”解耦：在OpenRing框架中，规划器仅提出路径和执行顺序，而本地守卫（local guard）仅允许不会导致环路闭合的移动或路径变更，且顺序具有时间绑定约束。该机制确保即使面对任意路径提案或规划器失效，环路也不会被关闭。通过引入双位置路段（two-place segments），系统可在扰动下维持交通流动，一旦扰动结束即可保证进展，并在入口停止时确保所有车辆最终退出。研究证明，在仅基于提议重规划的规则中，每个守卫的否决权均不可或缺，且完整计划的交叉顺序得以保持。然而，该保障存在代价：在任意停车条件下，无法实现超过 $ B/T_s （（（ B $ 为路段容量，$ T_s $ 为通行时间）的每路段吞吐量。实验表明，使用绑定顺序的三规划器在80/126次运行中出现死锁，而OpenRing在全部126次运行中均无死锁；其闭环吞吐量可媲美或超越最优基线，物理仿真亦未发现死锁或碰撞。

Abstract:Lifelong multi-agent path finding replans routes for automated guided vehicles, but deviations can invalidate a plan. With one-way lanes, a late vehicle or lost planner can close a ring of full segments. We separate how fast the floor runs from whether it keeps running. In OpenRing a planner proposes routes and an order, a local guard commits only moves and route changes that cannot close such a ring, and the order binds for a bounded time. Despite arbitrary proposals or planner loss, no ring closes. With two-place segments, traffic can continue under disturbances; progress is guaranteed once they end, and all vehicles exit if entries also stop. Among rules that reroute only on a proposal, every guard veto is necessary, and a clean plan keeps its crossing orders. The guarantee has a price: no rule that never stores a vehicle in a crossing under arbitrary stops carries more than B/T_s per segment of B places and traversal time T_s . With binding orders, three planners deadlock in 80 of 126 runs across eight floors. Inside OpenRing, none of the 126 runs deadlocks. OpenRing’s closed-loop throughput rivals or exceeds the best baseline’s. Physics simulations show no deadlocks or overlaps.

[MA-12] Omo: Giving Continuing AI-Agent Work a Place to Return To

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 编码代理（Generative AI Coding Agents）在用户离开后持续运行所带来的“回归难”问题：尽管代理可长时间自主执行任务，但用户返回时难以快速理解其当前状态、任务目标、已修改内容及下一步操作建议。现有系统仅提供会话列表，缺乏对上下文的可视化与持久化表达。为此，论文提出 Omo 系统，其核心解决方案是为每一段持续进行的代理工作赋予一个持久存在的“空间”（persistent place），实现工作状态的可追溯与可恢复。Omo 通过两种实现形式验证该理念：Omo Space 是一款开源 Minecraft 模组，将用户构建的房间与屏幕作为本地机器上的实时终端；Omo Theia 则将其扩展至可定制的集成开发环境（IDE），无缝嵌入编辑器与 Git 补丁界面。两者均支持在关闭视图后仍保持代理会话在宿主机上持续运行，从而确保上下文不丢失。研究还设计了实验以评估“返回特定空间”是否有助于用户正确接续代理工作。

作者: Kaviru Hapuarachchi,Harrison Edwards
机构: Omo Research(奥莫研究)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 4 pages, 1 composite figure (5 panels)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI coding agents now keep working while the people who started them are away. Coming back is the hard part: a session list tells you which agent is where, but not what it was asked to do, what it changed, or what to tell it next. We present Omo, which gives each piece of continuing agent work a persistent place to return to. We built the idea twice. Omo Space is an open-source Minecraft mod in which rooms and screens that people build are live terminals on their own machine. Omo Theia brings the same rooms and desks into a customizable IDE, one step away from the editor and the Git patch. Both keep agent sessions running on the host after the view is closed. We describe the two systems, four lessons from building them, and a study designed to test whether returning to a place helps people pick up agent work correctly.

[MA-13] Exercised Rarely Recovered: What Public Reports Say About Recovery in 50 AI Agent Harnesses and Runtimes

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在实际应用中因错误操作（如误删文件）或长时间运行崩溃导致的恢复难题，核心问题是：现有系统中的容错与恢复机制是否在真实场景中有效。其解决方案的关键在于通过系统性评估12个持久化运行时、26个代码生成代理测试框架及12个研究运行时，对八种恢复机制（如检查点恢复、事务回滚、补偿操作等）在真实使用中的表现进行量化分析。研究发现，尽管恢复机制几乎普遍被触发（11/12运行时和25/26测试框架有实际使用报告），但真正实现完整恢复的比例极低（仅19/128次报告成功），多数为部分恢复或失败；而检查点恢复与回滚机制的实际有效性也极为有限。更关键的是，研究型运行时虽在基准测试中宣称具备强一致性保障（如事务式回滚和补偿机制），但在真实运行中均未见报告，且无任何测试框架实际执行外部效应补偿，揭示了理论承诺与实践效果之间的巨大鸿沟。

Abstract:When an AI coding agent deletes the wrong files or a long agent run crashes, users fall back on recovery mechanisms: resume from a checkpoint, undo, ask for approval, read the log. Research runtimes promise stronger guarantees, such as saga-style compensation and transactional rollback. We ask what public evidence shows about whether either kind works in real use. Under a protocol frozen before data collection, we graded 12 persistent agent runtimes, 26 coding-agent harnesses and 12 research runtimes on eight recovery mechanisms, from not found to exercised in a real run, with two blind coding passes, adjudication and re-verification against archived sources. Recovery is exercised almost everywhere in practice: 11 of 12 runtimes and 25 of 26 harnesses have at least one real-use report. Yet of 128 such reports, only 19 describe the run fully recovering; 54 are partial and 45 failed. Checkpoint/resume recovered once in 27 reports, rollback once in 15. Research runtimes show the opposite profile: guarantees evaluated on benchmarks, none reported in operation, and compensation of external effects, their central guarantee, is offered by no harness at all.

[MA-14] Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在服务过程中因反复重传不断增长的执行历史而导致共享键值（Key-Value, KV）缓存需求激增的问题，进而限制了高带宽内存（HBM）中共享KV缓存容量，影响了智能体服务吞吐量。其核心挑战在于现有上下文压缩方法缺乏对全局缓存状态的可见性，而运行时KV管理器则缺少工具执行信息，难以精准识别可安全淘汰的上下文内容。论文提出Contexture，一种与框架和模型无关的运行时上下文淘汰架构，其关键创新在于将框架的完整对话历史与模型的执行上下文解耦，通过追踪标记到其原始工具操作，利用“覆盖”（supersession）机制识别出64%的最终历史标记为可移除候选；同时结合全局共享KV压力与前缀驻留状态的实时视图，动态判断淘汰时机，实现对缓存计算牺牲的合理权衡。该方案在不增加额外模型调用或训练的前提下，显著降低内存占用与解码阶段的KV流量，减少并发解码中的重填充干扰，实测在多个模型、框架与基准测试中，相比无淘汰、框架压缩、AgentDiet、Continuum等基线提升SLO下吞吐量20%-73%，相较观察掩码在五组配置中提升7%-63%，并使每完成会话的GPU能耗最多降低11%。此外，在H100上相较LMCache提升23%的SLO吞吐量，且真实智能体实验表明平均准确率提升1.4个百分点，优于未启用淘汰的基线，仅在最坏情况下损失3.7个百分点，远优于观察掩码导致的3%-28%性能下降。

Abstract:LLM agents such as Hermes, OpenClaw, and Codex repeatedly resend growing execution histories, increasing shared GPU key-value (KV) cache demand in high-bandwidth memory (HBM). We show that shared KV capacity limits agent-serving throughput. Existing context-reduction methods lack global cache-state visibility, while runtime KV managers lack tool-execution information. Tracing tokens to their originating tool operations reveals that later operations supersede earlier outputs and associated turns, identifying 64% of recorded final-history tokens as removal candidates. We present Contexture, a harness- and model-agnostic architecture for runtime context eviction. Contexture separates the harness’s full conversation history from the model’s execution context, reducing subsequent requests’ KV demand without modifying harness logic or model execution. It combines tool-execution information with global visibility into shared KV pressure and prefix residency: supersession identifies removal candidates, while runtime state determines when removal justifies sacrificing cached computation. This coordination reduces memory demand and decode KV traffic while limiting re-prefill interference with concurrent decoding, without additional model calls or training. Across two models, two harnesses, and two benchmarks, Contexture improves throughput under SLO by 20-73% over the best of no eviction, harness compaction, AgentDiet, and Continuum, and by 7-63% over observation masking in five of eight configurations, and reduces GPU energy per completed session by up to 11%. It also raises throughput under SLO by 23% over LMCache alone on H100. Live-agent experiments show a mean accuracy improvement of 1.4 percentage points over unloaded no eviction, with a worst-case loss of 3.7 points, while observation masking loses 3-28 points. [MA-15] racking and Limiting Unsupported Claim Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Provenance-Aware Framework

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体（multi-agent）流水线中未经证实的主张（unsupported claims）在传递过程中发生语义漂移与无关细节累积的问题，尤其关注这些变化如何影响信息的准确性与可信度。其核心解决方案在于引入一种具备溯源意识（provenance-aware）的框架，通过在各智能体间传递主张时同步携带其支持状态、来源、证据及传播历史等元数据，实现对信息完整性的追踪与约束。该框架不引入新证据，仅依赖已有信息进行推理与传递，从而有效抑制主张在跨代理流转过程中的语义偏移（semantic drift）和未支持内容的增殖（unsupported detail accretion），并通过量化评估证明其在保持主张一致性与可追溯性方面的显著优势。

Abstract:This research examines how unsupported claims change as they move through multi-agent pipelines. It also examines whether preserving provenance can reduce these changes. We test both homogeneous and heterogeneous pipelines. Homogeneous pipelines use the same model across agents, while heterogeneous pipelines use different models. We compare the baseline with a provenance-aware framework. The framework passes each claim with its support status, source, evidence and transmission history. No new evidence is introduced during transmission. We measure changes in claim meaning, unsupported detail accretion, semantic drift, and provenance preservation. These metrics show whether the framework limits unsupported changes as claims pass between agents.

[MA-16] SecretAgent : A Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy Protection against Vision Language Models

【速读】：该论文旨在解决视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在共享图像中泄露敏感信息（如地理位置、个人身份信息PII、年龄与性别等个人属性，甚至医疗图像中的隐私内容）的问题。现有防御方法虽能通过对抗扰动保护隐私，但普遍存在忽视图像质量、引入可见伪影的缺陷。本文提出SecretAgent，首个通用的多智能体框架，在保障图像视觉保真度的前提下实现对VLM的隐私防护。其核心解决方案在于：利用大语言模型（LLM）智能体迭代识别揭示隐私的视觉线索，并动态生成不可见扰动，同时协同一个外观审查智能体以拒绝产生可见伪影的候选方案。该框架包含两种互补变体：SecretAgent-Gradient通过六种代理编码器优化扰动以增强跨模型迁移能力；SecretAgent-Tool采用程序化噪声构造，显著提升感知保真度，在五个数据集中的三个表现最优。实验在四个隐私应用场景（地理定位、PII、人脸、医疗）及六个VLM上验证表明，SecretAgent在保持图像质量方面显著优于现有方法，且在所有任务中均达到最先进的隐私保护效果，并具备良好的跨模型泛化能力。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vision-language models (VLMs) can infer private information from shared images, including locations, personally identifiable information (PII), and personal attributes such as age and sex, even from medical images. Adversarial perturbations can protect such information against black-box VLMs, but existing methods overlook image quality and introduce visible artifacts into the images they protect. We present SecretAgent, the first general multi-agent framework that protects image privacy against VLMs while preserving visual fidelity. LLM agents iteratively locate the visual evidence that reveals private information and adapt an invisible perturbation to the target VLM’s answers and to an appearance reviewer agent, which rejects any candidate with visible artifacts. We instantiate SecretAgent with two complementary variants: SecretAgent-Gradient optimizes the perturbation through six surrogate encoders for cross-model transferability, and the gradient-free SecretAgent-Tool composes procedural noise and achieves the best perceptual fidelity on three of the five datasets. Experiments on four privacy applications (geolocation, PII, facial, and medical) across five datasets and six VLMs show that SecretAgent preserves image quality substantially better than existing methods while achieving state-of-the-art privacy protection in every application, and that its protection transfers to other VLMs.

[MA-17] Federated KPI Aggregation with Local Privacy Constraints and Coordinated OLAP Roll-Ups

【速读】：该论文旨在解决跨组织关键绩效指标（KPI）分析中因各机构独立管理数据仓库而产生的隐私与数据完整性冲突问题：在确保每个站点满足本地最小群体规模（minimum-cohort）隐私约束的前提下，如何实现全局KPI结果的完整聚合。其核心挑战在于，若各站点独立应用抑制规则，可能导致部分本地贡献被屏蔽，进而造成最终聚合结果不完整。解决方案的关键在于通过联邦式协同机制，预先协调各站点的OLAP（在线分析处理）粒度（granularity），使所有站点在相同且最不泛化的共同上卷（common roll-up）层级上进行数据发布。该方法由站点代理（site agent）协作完成，仅基于本地确定性函数进行能力协商、隐私验证与聚合计算，避免了中央数据集中化。实验表明，在四站点原型系统中，协调后的上卷策略实现了100%的贡献保留率，显著优于独立抑制下的78.3%；同时，动态能力状态的使用减少了无效请求与检查次数，提升了系统效率。研究证明，基于代理协同与粒度协调的联邦式KPI聚合在满足本地隐私约束下具有可行性。

Abstract:Cross-organizational KPI analysis can require aggregated results from independently administered data warehouses without centralizing detailed records. To limit disclosure from small local groups, a site can require a minimum number of contributing records before releasing a KPI value for a group. If each site applies this rule independently, different local contributions may be suppressed and the combined KPI can become incomplete. This paper investigates whether OLAP granularity can be coordinated before local query results are released so that all sites satisfy their local minimum-cohort rules and contribute at the same analytical level. The proposed method selects the least-generalized common roll-up accepted by every site. Site agents coordinate current capabilities and approved local execution across independently administered sites, with privacy checks and aggregate computation remaining deterministic local functions. In a four-site prototype, coordinated roll-up retained all contributions and reproduced the corresponding centralized result, compared with 78.3% retained under independent suppression. A capability-change experiment showed fewer candidate checks and replies and no unsupported requests when current site-agent state was used. The results demonstrate the feasibility of federated KPI aggregation under local privacy constraints through coordinated granularity selection and agent-based coordination.

[NLP-0] MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在长时序与持续交互场景中因需维护可复用的记忆状态而面临的内存与计算效率瓶颈问题。现有Transformer架构采用逐层、逐标记的键值（KV）缓存机制，导致GPU内存随上下文增长呈线性增加，计算复杂度达二次方级；而现有的线性时间架构虽通过压缩历史信息为固定大小的状态以降低开销，却难以保留细粒度语义细节。其核心解决方案在于提出MemOnce这一基础性架构，关键创新包含两点：一是记忆编码-解码机制，仅对最终层隐藏状态的小部分子集进行压缩存储为紧凑的记忆表示，并在需要时动态解码回注意力层所需的KV缓存；二是稀疏记忆注意力机制，针对每个连续输入自适应地检索相关记忆表示，且稀疏索引仅需在各层间一次性计算。二者协同实现了高效在线记忆加载与KV缓存解码，显著降低GPU内存占用并实现线性时间复杂度。实验表明，MemOnce在不同模型规模、上下文长度及训练范式下均优于Transformer及其他架构，例如将Qwen3.5-4B模型在100万上下文长度下的缓存内存减少1313倍，预填充延迟降低6.9倍，吞吐量提升3.5倍，整体内存性能提高5.77%；同时具备零样本泛化能力，在下游表示任务中表现媲美专用模型。

作者: Chang Nie,Chaoyou Fu,Songlin Liu,Yiqing Hu,Caifeng Shan
机构: Nanjing University(南京大学); University of Science and Technology of China(中国科学技术大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Project Page: this https URL

Abstract:Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313 \times and prefill latency by 6.9 \times at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5 \times and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.

[NLP-1] EA-Bench-BR: Can Coding Agents Turn a Branching Clinical Specification into Correct Code?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在医疗领域应用中因代码缺陷导致的“沉默错误”问题，即生成的代码虽能正常运行并返回看似合理的输出，但实际逻辑存在偏差或错误，尤其在临床决策支持系统（Clinical Decision Support System, CDS）中可能带来严重后果。其核心挑战在于如何有效评估和验证生成代码在真实医疗场景下的正确性与鲁棒性。解决方案的关键在于构建一个高度仿真的多专业转诊流程基准测试平台——TEA-Bench-BR，该平台基于巴西早期自闭症筛查路径（TEA），包含三个虚构但结构真实的筛查工具、多专业协作的转诊流程，并支持导出至符合国家标准的FHIR R4格式（含RNDS患者数据模型）。通过使用生成式模型Gemma 4作为编码代理，系统对144个任务中的6,798个隐藏病例进行测试，这些病例精准覆盖了参考实现的所有1,955个非等价变异体。实验结果表明，31B规模模型在三级任务中达到78.7%的解决率且通过超过99%的隐藏案例，其主要失败原因集中在输入校验而非临床逻辑判断；相比之下，12B模型表现显著下降，尤其在转诊触发任务上遗漏率达10.10%，而31B仅0.02%。此外，在英文版本任务中，31B在第三级任务的解决率提升至57.4%，反映出语言适配对代码质量的影响。最后，对修改版PHQ-9的污染探测实验未发现违反原始规则的错误，验证了系统的规则一致性。因此，该研究的关键贡献在于提出了一个具备高仿真度、可量化评估生成代码可靠性的基准框架，为医疗生成式AI的安全落地提供了可复现的验证手段。

类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Coding agents increasingly implement rules written by domain experts, and bugs in such code are silent: it runs and returns a plausible answer. We introduce TEA-Bench-BR, a benchmark built on the Brazilian pathway for early autism (TEA) screening: three fictitious instruments with the structure of real ones, a multi-professional referral flow, and export to FHIR R4 with the national RNDS profiles, all specified in Portuguese. A generator samples each task’s parameters (144 tasks, 6,798 hidden cases), and the hidden cases kill all 1,955 non-equivalent mutants of the reference. With Gemma 4 as the agent, the 12B solves 38.0% of single-instrument tasks and none at the FHIR level; the 31B solves 77.8%, 85.2% and 78.7% at levels 1 to 3 and passes over 99% of the hidden cases, its remaining failures mostly in input validation rather than clinical decisions. With the same tasks in English, the 31B solves 57.4% at level 3, as its code validates an identifier less often; the 12B’s, more often. The 12B misses 10.10% of the cases that call for referral; the 31B, 0.02%. A contamination probe on a modified PHQ-9 finds no error that follows the original rules.

[NLP-2] DistDNA: Language Model Fingerprinting under Stochastic Decoding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在部署时因随机解码（stochastic decoding）导致响应不一致的问题，从而影响基于行为指纹（behavioral fingerprints）的模型身份识别准确性。现有方法如LLM DNA对解码参数变化带来的响应波动处理能力有限，而直接建模响应分布虽为更优方向，却面临两大挑战：一是需从少量采样响应中估计分布，二是解码设置的改变可能与模型检查点（checkpoint）变更产生相似的响应差异，导致仅依赖指纹距离难以准确判断模型身份。为此，本文提出DistDNA，其核心创新在于将模型表示为条件于提示（prompt-conditional）的响应分布，并通过逐提示的最大均值差异（promptwise maximum mean discrepancy, MMD）进行模型比较。该方法无需训练分类器，而是通过计算待测模型与多个已知检查点在多种解码设置下的参考指纹之间的最小距离实现归属判定。理论分析表明，有限采样引入的方差项随响应数量 $ R $ 以 $ O(1/R) $ 的速率衰减。实验在115个模型检查点上的结果表明，DistDNA相较最强基线方法LLM DNA，识别准确率提升10.36%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27831
作者: Lifan Hu,Qian Yu,Zhaomin Wu,Bingsheng He
机构: National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 37 pages, 12 figures, 23 tables, including appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Behavioral fingerprints identify a large language model (LLM) from its responses to a shared set of prompts, enabling applications such as verifying whether a deployed model corresponds to the checkpoint it claims to be. Deployed models, however, are commonly served with stochastic decoding, under which the same model may produce different responses to an identical prompt, depending on an unknown temperature and top- p setting. Existing representations such as LLM DNA provide limited treatment of this variation. A natural remedy is to characterize models by their response distributions, which, however, raises two challenges. First, each distribution must be estimated from only a small number of sampled responses. Second, a change in decoding setting can alter responses to the same extent as a change of checkpoint. Consequently, fingerprint distances alone provide an incomplete basis for model identity, and identification typically relies on a classifier trained jointly on fingerprints from many checkpoints. We propose DistDNA, which represents a model by its prompt-conditional response distributions and compares models by promptwise maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). The model under examination is assigned to the known checkpoint whose reference fingerprints, collected at several decoding settings, lie nearest to its own, without training a classifier. We show that finite sampling adds variance-dependent terms to the expected squared fingerprint distance, with these terms decreasing as O(1/R) for equal response counts, where R is the number of responses per prompt. Experiments across 115 model checkpoint entries demonstrate that DistDNA improves identification accuracy over the strongest baseline, LLM DNA, by 10.36%.

[NLP-3] SLP-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Acoustic Claims of Reasoning Audio Language Models on Clinical Speech ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语音语言模型（Audio Language Models, ALMs）在临床语音分析中对声学特征描述的可信度评估问题。现有评估方法仅关注模型最终答案的准确性，而忽视了其在“思维链”（chain of thought）中关于说话人语音特征的中间判断是否符合临床语言病理学家的感知评级。这一缺陷导致模型在生成声学推理时存在事实性不足、鲁棒性差及表述不一致等问题。为此，本文提出Speech Language Pathologist Bench（SLP-Bench），一个基于临床语言病理学家感知评级的基准测试体系，用于系统评估模型在25个感知维度上对声学特征的每一条推理声明的事实性、重采样稳定性以及重述与多问一致性。实验表明，十种零样本推理型ALM在声明平衡准确率仅为0.52–0.58，且多数声明在重采样或重述后发生变化；最一致的模型并非最准确的模型。通过使用GRPO（Generalized Reward Policy Optimization）对7B规模的ALM进行微调，以奖励与临床专家评价一致的声学陈述，可将声明平衡准确率从0.54提升至0.60，平均Kappa值从0.39升至0.61，同时保持对单维问题的答案准确率。该研究的关键在于构建了一个面向临床语音分析中声学推理可信度的精细化评估框架，并验证了基于人类专家反馈的强化学习微调策略能有效提升模型推理的可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27810
作者: Côme Hosxe,Rachid Riad,Quentin Spinat
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: 5 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, submitted to ICASSP 2027 workshop “Explainability, Robustness, and Controllability of Language Modeling for Speech and Audio”

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Audio language models (ALMs) can answer clinical questions from speech, outperforming baselines built on handcrafted acoustic features. Reasoning ALMs generate a chain of thought that refers to properties of the speaker’s voice before predicting. Each statement the model makes about the voice needs to be checked against clinicians’ perceptual ratings of the same recording. On clinical speech, existing evaluations score only the final answer. We introduce Speech Language Pathologist Bench (SLP-Bench), a benchmark grading each acoustic claim in the chain of thought against clinicians’ perceptual ratings of the same recording. It covers five clinician-rated datasets and 25 perceptual dimensions, and assesses claims for factuality, stability under resampling, and consistency across reworded and different questions. Across ten open-weight reasoning ALMs evaluated zero-shot, claim balanced accuracy ranges from 0.52 to 0.58, claims change under resampling and rewording, and the most consistent models are not the most factual. Fine-tuning a 7B ALM with GRPO on a reward for claims that agree with clinicians raises its claim balanced accuracy from 0.54 to 0.60 and its mean kappa from 0.39 to 0.61, while preserving answer accuracy on per-dimension questions. SLP-Bench is available upon request, subject to approval by the providers of each dataset.

[NLP-4] Evaluating Prompting Strategies for Zero-Shot Multilingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式大语言模型（LLM）在零样本多语言环境下进行复杂目标-方面-情感三元组检测（TASD）任务的能力不足问题，尤其关注开放权重模型在跨语言家族与多领域场景下的表现。现有观点普遍集中于英语语境或依赖微调特定任务模型，缺乏对通用大模型在无标注数据支持下处理复合情感三元组提取的系统性评估。其解决方案的关键在于通过四种提示范式（单体式、思维链、顺序式、顺序精炼式）对7个指令微调的开放权重模型（参数规模8B至35B，涵盖密集型与混合专家MoE架构）在12种语言和3个领域的零样本多语言TASD任务中进行系统性评估。研究发现，直接的单体式提示在零样本条件下表现最优，显著优于多步分解策略；密集型模型整体性能优于稀疏型MoE架构；初步方面词召回率构成关键瓶颈，而多步分解反而降低抽取质量；迭代精炼仅在大模型上部分恢复性能，且在小模型上引发净负向过度精炼。此外，生成量分析表明多步策略带来高达2.38倍的令牌开销却未提升F1分数，进一步确立单体式提示在多语言方面情感分析中的高效性与优越性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27807
作者: Jakub Šm{í}d,Pavel Kr{á}l
机构: University of West Bohemia in Pilsen (西波希米亚大学皮尔森分校); NTIS - New Technologies for the Information Society, University of West Bohemia in Pilsen (新信息技术研究所，西波希米亚大学皮尔森分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to the 19th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2027)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:While large language models (LLMs) have advanced natural language understanding, their ability to perform complex target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD) – a key task within aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) – in zero-shot multilingual settings remains underexplored. Existing ABSA research predominantly focuses on English or relies on fine-tuned task-specific models, leaving a gap in understanding how open-weight LLMs handle compound sentiment triplet extraction across diverse language families and domains. We present a systematic evaluation of zero-shot multilingual TASD across 12 languages and three domains using seven instruction-tuned open-weight models – ranging from 8B to 35B parameters across dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures – under four prompting paradigms: monolithic, chain-of-thought, sequential, and sequential refine. Our results show that direct monolithic prompting achieves strong zero-shot performance, outperforming multi-step pipelines, while dense models consistently outperform sparse MoE architectures. Through fine-grained error taxonomy profiling and step-level pipeline tracking, we demonstrate that initial aspect term recall forms a hard bottleneck, whereas multi-step decomposition degrades extraction quality; iterative refinement only partially recovers this loss on larger models while inducing net-negative over-refinement on smaller architectures. Finally, generation volume analysis shows that multi-step strategies incur up to 2.38x token overhead without F1 gains, establishing monolithic prompting as the most effective and efficient paradigm for multilingual ABSA.

[NLP-5] Enhancing Attention with Higher-Order Attention

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前解码器型大语言模型（decoder large language models）在生成过程中依赖自回归（autoregressive, AR）注意力机制所存在的局限性，尽管现有机制在形式上为自回归，但其实际建模能力仍存在改进空间。其核心问题在于如何更有效地增强生成过程中的自回归概率信息含量，以提升生成质量与推理效率。解决方案的关键在于引入三种非严格自回归但能强化自回归特性的新型注意力机制：第一，基于互信息（mutual information, MI）分解为条件互信息（conditional mutual information, CMI）的机制，通过关联关键词元与查询词元对来增强上下文表征；第二，高阶注意力机制，引入连续关键词元与查询词元之间的相关性，捕捉更长程依赖；第三，基于广义最大熵原理（generalized maximum entropy principle）构建跨序列词元集的注意力表达，实现对全局语境信息的建模。这三类方法共同提升了自回归概率的信息密度，进而优化生成性能，并在对比解码与自回归概率系统性分析中验证了其有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27764
作者: R. I. Cukier
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Current decoder large language models rely on a combination of attention, feed forward and residual layers. The attention used is autoregressive (AR) though this is not strictly correct, as we note. That motivates the introduction of other attention methods that, while also not strictly AR, do enhance the AR character. One is based on a decomposition of mutual information (MI) into a set of Conditional MIs (CMIs) that correlate key tokens with pairs of query tokens. A second, higher-order attention, introduces correlations between contiguous key and query tokens. A third introduces correlations between a set of key and query tokens and uses a Generalized Maximum Entropy Principle to obtain an attention expression spanning a sequence of tokens. All these methods may enhance the information content of the autoregressive probabilities that are used in inference/generation. Applications to contrastive decoding and a systematic analysis of autoregressive probabilities are presented.

[NLP-6] From Novel Combinations to Informative Absence: Structural permission communicative opportunity and form choice in language learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言学习者如何推断新表达式在语法上是否被允许，以及在持续缺失的情况下如何将其作为否定证据的问题。其核心挑战在于区分语义可及性与形式选择之间的混淆，并有效利用沉默（即省略）作为负向证据。解决方案的关键在于提出一种生成式理论，通过反事实的表达机会（counterfactual expression opportunities）将语法许可、交际机会与形式选择三者解耦。该理论首先基于共享预测延续，从30种人工语法中恢复对未见词构配对的结构许可（平均AUC达0.945，经120句训练后）；其次，在层次不确定性框架下，推导出联合证据定律，揭示省略行为与语境多样性及语境内重复性的关系，并建立精确的有限样本语境精炼不等式，使相关表达的出现能校准预期使用频率，从而增强负向证据的敏感性；最后，通过场景级机会观测，分离出语义可及性与形式选择的影响，实证分析表明，意义条件下的限制性判断显著提升了对保留生产数据的预测能力（399名参与者，每单位产出提升+0.036纳特）。此外，自然语料分析显示儿童言语中存在超越词汇、数量和依存角色控制的源层级使用聚类，支持层次化使用率不确定性的建模。综合来看，该研究揭示了交际机会的组织与校准机制如何决定语言缺失的证据价值。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27762
作者: Yanzhe Zhao
机构: Tianjin University (天津大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Neurons and Cognition (q-bio.NC)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language learners must infer which novel expressions are grammatically licensed and when continued absence is evidence against them. Our generative theory unites these capacities via counterfactual expression opportunities, decomposing utterance generation into structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice. First, shared predictive continuations recover structural permission for unseen word-construction pairings across 30 artificial grammars (mean AUC 0.945 after 120 sentences). Second, under hierarchical uncertainty, we derive a joint evidence law linking omissions to context diversity and within-context repetition, and an exact finite-sample context-refinement inequality. Thus, observing related expressions calibrates expected use to sharpen negative evidence, and higher expected use can drive steeper posterior declines for stronger-permission candidates (reversing initial order after six omissions in a fixed-rate example). Third, we prove that while raw counts confound semantic availability and form selection, scene-level opportunity observations identify both. Empirically, reanalyzing adult and child artificial-language experiments shows meaning-conditioned restriction; judgments of restricted combinations improve held-out production predictions across 399 participants (+0.036 nats/production). Naturalistic child-directed and child speech (11 families, six corpora) shows pervasive source-level usage clustering beyond lexical, number, and dependency-role controls, grounding hierarchical rate uncertainty. Finally, modeling causative judgments across five languages shows that structural compatibility and calibrated usage probabilities draw on distinct distributional, semantic, and discriminative cues. Together, these findings show how the organization and calibration of communicative opportunities govern the evidential value of linguistic absence.

[NLP-7] RoSci: Exploring Robustness in Science VLMs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在真实科学场景中面对信息错误（如不一致）或信息缺失（如不充分）时的脆弱性问题。现有模型通常假设输入信息完整且准确，但在实际应用中，数据常存在异常或不全，导致模型推理失效。为此，论文提出“科学模型鲁棒性”（Scientific Model Robustness）的概念，定义了模型在遭遇信息误差或信息损失时检测异常、评估问题可解性以及进行自我校准的能力。其关键解决方案是构建RoSci-Bench——一个包含1,220个样本的诊断基准，采用种子变异策略覆盖六类退化类型，用于系统评估模型在复杂信息状态下的表现；同时提出RoSci-Agent框架，通过“解析-验证-决策”（Parse-Verify-Decide）的流水线机制，在推理前对前提条件进行核查，从而有效提升模型在面对无效或不完整前提时的判断能力。实验表明，与独立运行的VLM相比，RoSci-Agent在整体鲁棒性评分上显著更优，为多模态推理社区提供了统一的评估标准，以衡量模型在何时回答、请求澄清或拒绝回答科学问题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27750
作者: Junying Wang,Yijin Guo,Yalun Wu,Ziheng Jiao,Farong Wen,Qihang Yan,Wenzhe Li,Ye Shen,Qi Jia,Chunyi Li,Zicheng Zhang,Guangtao Zhai
机构: Fudan University (复旦大学); Shanghai AI Laboratory (上海人工智能实验室); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Nanyang Technological University (南洋理工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: 18 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable significant progress in scientific tasks. However, these models are generally assumed to be presented with complete and accurate information, overlooking the challenges of erroneous/missing information in wild scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce the concept of Scientific Model Robustness, which defines a model’s ability to detect anomalies, assess solvability, and perform self-calibration when faced with Information Error (inconsistencies) or Information Loss (insufficiency). Specifically, we present RoSci-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,220 samples using a seed-variant strategy across six degradation types. To address VLM fragility, we further propose RoSci-Agent, a framework that employs a Parse-Verify-Decide pipeline to vet premises before reasoning. The evaluated VLMs sometimes answer questions whose premises are invalid or incomplete. RoSci-Agent achieves a higher Overall Robustness Score than the evaluated standalone VLMs. RoSci-Bench gives the multimodal reasoning community a common test of when models answer, request clarification, or reject a scientific question.

[NLP-8] AutoOntologyBench: A Task-Grounded Benchmark for Agent ic Knowledge Engineering

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自主科学研究所面临的领域知识获取与整合难题，特别是在生成式 AI 代理（Generative AI Agents）从软件工程（SWE）向自主科研拓展过程中，如何有效构建并利用可复用的知识表示。其核心挑战在于：现有方法依赖人工构建的本体（Ontology）或静态知识库，难以实现大规模、动态的知识自适应与扩展。本文提出的关键解决方案是引入 AutoOntologyBench——一个以任务为导向的基准测试平台，涵盖18个真实世界知识源、7个领域共19,947个经审计的任务，并支持源生验证（source-native verification）。通过在九种前沿模型上对比检索增强与代理自建本体的性能表现，研究发现：基于检索的本体构建能使任务成功率提升6.1个百分点，但相比专家构建的参考本体仍存在13.0点差距，揭示了自主知识获取仍是实现可扩展科学智能的核心瓶颈。该研究首次系统评估了自主本体构建的实际效益，为下一代自主科研代理的设计提供了关键实证依据。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27734
作者: Minye Shao,Chenghao Xiao,Xingyue Zhao,Yang Long
机构: Durham University; Shanghai University of Finance and Economics; Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Peking Union Medical College; Alibaba DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Foundation-model agents are increasingly extending beyond software engineering (SWE) into autonomous scientific research, where acquiring and integrating domain knowledge remains a critical challenge. Recent industrial advances have increasingly adopted knowledge graphs and ontology-based semantic layers to organize heterogeneous knowledge into reusable representations. We ask: Can autonomous agents construct ontologies that help them solve real tasks, and do they offer measurable benefits over alternative knowledge representations? Existing benchmarks evaluate ontology correctness or agent task success in isolation, leaving the value of autonomously acquired knowledge unresolved. We therefore introduce AutoOntologyBench, a task-grounded benchmark comprising 19,947 audited tasks grounded in 18 real-world knowledge sources across 7 domains, with source-native verification. Spanning Application, Repair, Organization, and Construction, AutoOntologyBench compares nine frontier-model agents under matched knowledge representations. Layered on retrieval, agent-built ontologies add 6.1 points of task success, yet trail an expert-derived reference by 13.0, identifying autonomous knowledge acquisition as the bottleneck to scalable scientific research. Code and resources are available at this https URL.

[NLP-9] Beyond Math Code and Logic: Do Reasoning Models Transfer to Scientific Argumentation?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式AI在科学论述中进行有效论证推理的能力不足问题，尤其是在论点识别、证据评估与回应构建等关键环节表现薄弱。尽管前沿语言模型在数学、编程和逻辑推理任务上表现出色，但在面对科研论文、同行评审意见及资助提案等真实科学语境下的复杂论证任务时仍存在显著能力缺口。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种显式的论证推理过程结构化训练框架，通过在训练中明确引导模型遵循科学论证的逻辑流程（如论点提取、反驳生成与话语层面推理），从而系统性提升其在科学论述中的表现。该方法所生成的轻量化模型不仅在多项任务上达到甚至超越大型专有系统的性能，且具备良好的泛化能力，可在未见过的对话场景中实现跨任务推理迁移。研究结果表明，有效的科学论证并非单纯由模型规模带来的涌现特性，而是依赖于专门设计的、以推理为导向的训练机制，为构建真正可参与科学交流的智能系统提供了可行路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27722
作者: Buse Sibel Korkmaz,Antonio del Rio Chanona
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Scientific discourse depends on argumentative reasoning: identifying claims, evaluating evidence, and constructing coherent responses. While recent advances in reasoning-capable language models have demonstrated strong performance on mathematical, coding, and logical benchmarks, their ability to engage in scientific argumentation remains unclear. We present the first systematic evaluation of language models across seven tasks spanning argument mining, rebuttal generation, and discourse-level reasoning using research papers, peer reviews, and grant proposals. Our study reveals that even frontier models with strong general reasoning skills struggle with domain-specific argumentative tasks, highlighting a fundamental capability gap. To address this, we introduce a training framework that explicitly scaffolds the argumentative reasoning process in language models, substantially improving their competence in scientific discourse. The resulting compact models approach or exceed the performance of much larger proprietary systems and generalize to unseen conversational settings, demonstrating reasoning transfer beyond task-specific supervision. These findings underscore that effective scientific argumentation is not an emergent property of scale, but requires explicit reasoning-aware training, and they point toward practical pathways for building AI systems that can contribute meaningfully to scientific discourse.

[NLP-10] Decision Models for Multilingual Emotion Classification: A Comparative Study Against LLM s and Encoders

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言情感分类任务中，零样本（zero-shot）决策模型与微调的多语言编码器之间性能对比不充分的问题，尤其关注在无标注数据情况下是否可替代微调，以及决策格式相较于通用大语言模型（LLM）的优势。其核心解决方案的关键在于：通过在10个社交媒体数据集、5种语言上对三种零样本决策模型（Jev、OpenAI Decisions、Strands Decider 2B）和两种大语言模型（GPT-6 Luna、Qwen3.5-2B）进行系统性评估，并与两个经过微调的多语言编码器（tabularisai、XLM-EMO）进行对比，揭示了零样本方法在多数场景下仍落后于微调模型，但在跨数据集泛化能力上显著优于仅在其他数据集上微调的模型；同时发现决策模型相比生成式LLM能提供更低延迟和每选项概率输出，且其性能提升主要源于训练方式而非决策格式本身。研究还表明，尽管微调在最大数据集GoEmotions上具有明显优势，但零样本系统作为无需标注数据的默认方案仍表现出强大竞争力，其结果稳定性（标准差约1点）亦支持其可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27721
作者: Alessandro Piccolo,Francesco De Nicolò,Francesco Manco,Eufemia Lella
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 36 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Decision models receive a question with a closed list of answers and return a probability for each answer instead of free text. They promise low latency and robustness to prompt wording, but no study has compared several of them with fine-tuned encoders across languages. We ask whether systems used without training on labelled data (zero-shot) can replace fine-tuning, and what the decision format adds over a general-purpose large language model (LLM). We compare three decision models (Jev, OpenAI Decisions, Strands Decider 2B) and two LLMs (GPT-6 Luna, Qwen3.5-2B), given Italian instructions, with two fine-tuned multilingual encoders (tabularisai, XLM-EMO) on four emotions (joy, sadness, anger, fear) in 10 social-media datasets in five languages, with paired difference and equivalence tests. The three best zero-shot systems (two decision models and one LLM) score on average about one macro-F1 point below an encoder fine-tuned on the target dataset; our test sets cannot exclude a gap of 4-5 points, and on single datasets either approach wins by up to 22 points. They beat encoders fine-tuned on another dataset by 8-15 points, though against XLM-EMO this may not extend to new datasets, and instructions in each text’s language change their results by under 1 point. Exploratorily, they beat the strongest public emotion model used as is by about 6 points. OpenAI’s decision endpoint matches GPT-6 Luna, the LLM it runs on, at a fifth of its median latency, and a 2-billion-parameter decision model beats a same-size general LLM by 10 points, owing to its training, not the decision format. The best zero-shot systems, the LLM included, have an SD of about 1 point across prompts. Without labelled data they are a strong default, and decision models add lower latency and, unlike generative LLM use, per-option probabilities. Fine-tuning won by a wide margin only on the largest dataset, GoEmotions.

[NLP-11] Hy-MT3: More Accurate Robust and Practical Multilingual Translation Models in the Wild

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言机器翻译中准确性、完整性与指令遵循能力不足，以及在特定工业场景（如游戏本地化和图像翻译）下性能受限的核心问题。其解决方案的关键在于：构建第三代多语言翻译模型Hy-MT3系列，通过大规模高质量领域数据训练与专业评估体系优化，在保持较低计算开销的前提下显著提升翻译质量——尤其在真实场景数据上，错误率降低43%以上，指令遵循错误减少40%，并实现从38到102种语言的覆盖扩展；其中，采用稀疏激活架构的Hy-MT3-30B-A3B（仅激活30亿参数）在非思考模式下超越包括Qwen3.8-Max、Kimi-K3.1-Pro等在内的多个旗舰模型，并接近顶级闭源思考型模型表现，同时推理计算消耗低于同类模型30倍以上；此外，针对游戏本地化与图像翻译两大工业场景，分别引入专业数据集与评估机制，使模型在核心指标上达到或超越闭源领先模型水平，并支持通过开源工具链无缝集成至开发流程；最后，提出基于评分标准的自动化评估框架TransRubric，其在WMT26基准测试中表现优于现有评估方法，且与人工评价更一致，提升了评估稳定性与可靠性。

Abstract:Hy-MT3 is the third generation of the Hunyuan multilingual translation model family, including \textbfHy-MT3-1.8B, \textbfHy-MT3-7B and \textbfHy-MT3-30B-A3B (MoE). Compared with Hy-MT2, Hy-MT3 translates \textbfmore accurately, more completely and more faithfully to user constraints: on real-world scenario data, the share of samples with mistranslations is reduced by \textbf43%, omissions or additions by \textbf74%, and instruction-following errors by \textbf40%, while language coverage is expanded from \textbf38 to 102 languages. With only 3B activated parameters, \textbfHy-MT3-30B-A3B achieves the best overall performance among all evaluated models in non-thinking mode, including flagship models such as Qwen3.8-Max, Kimi-K3.1-Pro and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and approaches the strongest closed-source thinking models such as GPT-6.1-Sol and Gemini-4-Argon, while surpassing models that consume \textbfmore than 30 \times its inference compute. Beyond general translation, Hy-MT3 is optimized for two industrial scenarios. For \textbfgame localization, built with high-quality game-domain data and a professional evaluation system from the Honor of Kings team, Hy-MT3-30B-A3B matches or outperforms strong closed-source models such as Gemini 3.1 Pro on all core metrics, and can be plugged into game development pipelines through an open-source toolchain. For \textbfimage translation, Hy-MT3 improves context understanding and error correction to better tolerate OCR errors, achieving the best result among models of comparable size. Finally, we open-source \textbfTransRubric, a rubric-based automatic evaluation suite for translation, which outperforms other evaluation schemes on the WMT26 metrics shared task test set and is more stable with respect to human evaluation.

[NLP-12] Auditing Post-Training Unlearning in Diffusion Language Models using Sparse Autoencoders NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决扩散语言模型（Diffusion Language Models, DLMs）中机器遗忘（machine unlearning）的隐私保护问题，即在保留模型对合法信息的生成能力的同时，有效消除特定数据对模型的影响。由于DLM通过迭代去噪过程生成文本，其内部表示随去噪阶段动态变化，因此传统静态遗忘方法难以适配此类模型。本文的关键解决方案在于：识别与需遗忘数据相关的特征，并在不同去噪阶段自适应地抑制这些特征。研究采用基于top-k稀疏自编码器（sparse autoencoders）与去噪状态重放（denoising-state replay）的方法，对比了静态抑制与阶段自适应抑制的效果。结果表明，遗忘相关特征在不同去噪阶段存在显著动态变化，但仅追踪这些动态变化并未在当前实验条件下可靠提升遗忘-保留权衡性能。本研究为未来在DLM中构建和评估以训练后隐私保护为目标的机器遗忘机制提供了初步的实证基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27652
作者: Yunha Seo,Changhoon Kim
机构: Soongsil University (松岛大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 14 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Inference-Time AI Privacy (InfPriv 2026)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Machine unlearning is an approach to privacy protection: it aims to remove the influence of designated data while preserving the model’s behavior on information that should be retained. While a growing body of work investigates this objective in autoregressive large language models, machine unlearning remains underexplored in diffusion language models (DLMs). DLMs generate text through iterative denoising, exposing partially masked states whose internal representations change throughout the generation process. This raises a DLM-specific question: can selective forgetting improve by identifying forget-data-associated features and adapting their suppression across denoising stages? We conduct a controlled investigation of this question in LLaDA-8B-Instruct. To evaluate the unlearning of knowledge plausibly encoded during pre-training, we use WMDP as our forget-domain benchmark. Using top-k sparse autoencoders and denoising-state replay, we compare static and stage-adaptive feature suppression. We find substantial shifts in forget-data-associated features across denoising stages, but tracking these dynamics alone does not reliably improve the forget-retain trade-off at the evaluated operating points. Together, our study provides an initial empirical foundation for developing and evaluating machine unlearning as a post-training privacy mechanism in DLMs.

[NLP-13] Potential emergence in LLM agents : a statistical physics perspective

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在后训练（post-training）过程中行为演化机制不明确的问题，尤其关注其如何根据人类偏好或语料统计特性调整推理行为。其核心挑战在于缺乏对智能体状态演化的可量化描述与预测能力。本文提出的解决方案关键在于引入“智能体状态”（agent states）作为中间变量，构建基于统计物理的理论框架：通过定义一个配分函数（partition function），建模理想条件下KL正则化的状态转移分布，并追踪全局势能结构（global potential）、平均奖励（mean reward）与状态熵（state entropy）的变化。实验在Qwen3.5-9B的两个任务——安全测试选择与物理推理审计中验证了该方法的有效性，结果显示后训练过程中势能结构显著增强，且奖励与状态熵的协同变化提供了内在一致性证据，表明该框架能够定量刻画后训练对智能体行为组织的动态影响。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27618
作者: Zhuo-Yang Song,Hua Xing Zhu
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Adaptation and Self-Organizing Systems (nlin.AO)
备注: 21 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:There has been significant recent interest in understanding the behaviour of LLM agents from the perspective of human preferences or corpus statistics. In this paper we propose agent states as intermediate variables through which post-training can be measured and predicted. From a statistical physics perspective, we study the emergence of a global potential which governs the transition of state in LLM agent reasoning. We introduce a partition function to model the ideal KL-regularised transition distribution and track potential structure, mean reward and state entropy. We demonstrate our approach in two Qwen3.5-9B tasks: safety-test selection and physics-reasoning auditing. We observe that the potential structure strengthens during post-training as predicted from our framework, while joint changes in reward and state entropy provide consistency evidence. States thus provide a quantitative description of how post-training organises agent behaviour.

[NLP-14] asklets: A Unit-Test Benchmark for Language Model Architectures

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型中序列混合层（sequence-mixing layers）计算能力评估缺乏统一标准的问题。现有研究在任务选择、形式化定义及评估方法上存在差异，导致不同架构之间的性能比较难以进行。为此，作者提出了Tasklets基准，一个由小型合成任务组成的评估集，用于系统性地探测模型在记忆回溯（recall）、序列操作（sequence manipulation）和状态追踪（state tracking）等基础能力上的表现。其解决方案的关键在于将这些任务按所测试的核心能力进行分类组织，并提供统一的实验设置与可复现的代码实现，从而支持对多种层结构类型在小规模模型上的可控对比实验，实现了低成本、高可重复性的新架构评估。

Abstract:We introduce Tasklets, a benchmark of small synthetic tasks for evaluating the computational capabilities of language model sequence-mixing layers. These tasks probe foundational capabilities such as recall, sequence manipulation, and state tracking. Such tasks are widely used in architecture research, but differences in task selection, formulation, and evaluation make comparisons across studies difficult. Tasklets brings these tasks together, organizing them by the capabilities they test and providing a shared setup for evaluating how different architectural layer types learn fundamental computations. We compare a broad range of layer types through controlled experiments with small models. Our task implementations and evaluation code support reproducible, low-cost testing of new architectural proposals: this https URL.

[NLP-15] Alliance Rupture and Repair in Simulating Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Dialogues

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决认知行为疗法（Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, CBT）模拟系统中缺乏对治疗联盟（working alliance）状态动态追踪与修复能力的问题。现有CBT模拟器虽能模拟来访者抵抗行为并遵循结构化治疗计划，但通常忽略治疗联盟的隐性状态变化，无法支持咨询师在多轮对话中识别、修复关系破裂并相应调整后续干预策略。其解决方案的关键在于提出ALLYSimulation框架，该框架为每位来访者引入一个隐藏的治疗联盟状态，用以控制其参与开放度；咨询师代理仅通过对话内容感知来访者的行为信号，需自主判断联盟是否出现破裂，并实施修复与会话重规划。实验结果表明，ALLY生成的咨询策略流程与情感动态更接近真实CBT实践，且在咨询质量（CTRS）和人际技能（FIS-T）评估中得分最高；20名持证治疗师的专家评估亦证实模拟的联盟破裂具有现实合理性，修复与重规划过程整体恰当有效。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27544
作者: Jian Chai,Yitian Yang,Siqi Liu,Yi-Chia Wang,Yi-Chieh Lee
机构: National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学); Carnegie Mellon University(卡内基梅隆大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), routine work can strain the client-counselor working alliance, and the counselor must then notice the rupture, repair it, and adapt the work that follows. Existing CBT simulators model client resistance and follow structured treatment plans, but rarely track alliance state or allow counselors to repair ruptures over multiple turns and revise their plans accordingly. We present ALLY, a simulation framework that brings alliance rupture, repair, and replanning into ongoing CBT dialogue. Each client has a hidden alliance state that governs how openly the client engages. Like a real counselor, the counselor agent sees only the dialogue. It must notice when the client pulls back or pushes against the work, repair the rupture, and replan the rest of the session around what it has learned. Automatic evaluation shows that ALLY’s counselors are closer to real CBT counselors than those of existing public synthetic datasets in strategy flow and emotional dynamics, and that ALLY is rated highest overall in counseling quality (CTRS) and interpersonal skill (FIS-T). An expert evaluation with 20 licensed therapists also finds the simulated ruptures plausible and the repairs and replanning largely appropriate.

[NLP-16] Open CDLM: A Benchmark and Library for Continuous Diffusion Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决连续扩散语言模型（Continuous Diffusion Language Models, CDLMs）评估中存在的关键问题：现有评估方法在衡量模型拟合度与生成文本分布特性方面存在局限性。具体而言，基于似然的评估常报告离散负对数似然的变分上界，其松弛项（slack）可能导致模型比较结果失真；而基于生成样本的评估通常采用生成困惑度与序列内一元语法熵的组合，这些指标可能在采样器反复输出相同文本时仍保持良好，从而无法有效反映生成多样性。为此，论文提出Open CDLM——一个用于评估CDLM及其采样器的基准测试框架，并配套开发了开源库以支持可复现的比较实验。其解决方案的关键在于：在似然评估方面，明确指出报告的困惑度边界所支持的模型拟合比较范围及其对评估流程的依赖性；在样本评估方面，引入核文本差异（Kernel Text Discrepancy, KTD）来对比生成文本与真实文本的分布，并辅以多样性、有效性与覆盖率等诊断指标。通过在受控的OpenWebText实验中验证，当用单一文本的重复副本替代原语料时，传统生成评分依然表现良好，但MAUVE能够检测到生成坍缩现象，且其响应效果取决于文本表示方式和扰动类型。本研究标志着Open CDLM作为开放源代码项目的起点，未来将持续维护与扩展，欢迎社区贡献。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27536
作者: Hao Jiang,Ruixi Chen,Jiayi Han,Yulei Sun,Yujian Chen,Gen Li,Brian.K Chen,Guang Cheng,Weijian Luo,Tianyang Hu
机构: Polyadic Research Group; SAGA Lab, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen; School of Computer Science, Peking University; The Chinese University of Hong Kong; National University of Singapore; University of California, Los Angeles; Dots Studio, Xiaohongshu
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reliable comparisons of continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) require evaluating both model fit and the distribution of generated text. Two common practices leave this goal only partially addressed. Likelihood-based evaluation often reports a variational upper bound on discrete negative log-likelihood, whose slack can confound comparisons. Generated-sample-based evaluation commonly combines generative perplexity with within-sequence unigram entropy; both scores can remain favorable even when a sampler produces the same text on every draw. We introduce \textbfOpen CDLM, a benchmark for evaluating CDLMs and their samplers, and describe the design of an accompanying open-source library to support reproducible comparisons. For likelihood-based evaluation, we clarify which comparisons of model fit are supported by reported perplexity bounds and how those conclusions depend on the evaluation procedure. For sample-based evaluation, we use \textitKernel Text Discrepancy (\textbfKTD) to compare collections of generated and real texts, alongside diagnostics for diversity, validity, and coverage. In controlled OpenWebText experiments, replacing a collection of texts with copies of a single selected passage improves both conventional generation scores. MAUVE detects the resulting collapse, and its response to other perturbations depends on the text representation and the type of perturbation. This work marks the beginning of Open CDLM as an open-source project for CDLM research. We will maintain and extend the library over time and welcome contributions from the community.

[NLP-17] PaMuk-Bench: A Parallel Multilingual Multitask Benchmark for Vision-Language Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在低资源语言中性能显著下降的问题，尤其受限于缺乏标注数据集。其核心挑战在于现有VLMs在英语等高资源语言上表现优异，但在阿拉伯语、丹麦语、法语、印地语、意大利语和罗马尼亚语等低资源语言上的泛化能力不足。为此，论文提出PaMuk-Bench——一个新型的平行多语言多任务基准测试集，包含超过10,000条经人工筛选的英文提示，并通过半自动流程翻译至六种目标语言。该基准涵盖文本到图像生成、图像描述、基于内容的图像检索、图像生成难度估计及图像检索难度估计等多种任务，结合平行翻译与生成/检索图像，支持跨语言、跨任务的系统性评估。解决方案的关键在于构建高质量、可比的多语言对齐数据集，从而有效促进VLMs在不同语言间的公平比较与性能提升。实证结果表明，零样本预训练的英文及多语言VLMs在性能上显著劣于微调后的模型，验证了PaMuk-Bench在缩小多语言间性能差距方面的有效性。

类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
